description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. School campus polygons and their centroids cover public/private primary and secondary schools, universities, colleges and technical schools. The native layers expose point, polygon geometry and named attributes, including NAME, ADDRESS, CITY, ZIP, DISTRICT, DIST_NO. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. These paired geometry representations share the same campus scope and PRS_ID field, so they are one resource. Enrolment, capacity and current service status are not stated. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
